name: Xero
description: Check your P&L, cash position, outstanding invoices, top customers and more — directly from Claude. Xero surfaces real-time financial summaries with flexible date ranges, year-over-year comparisons, and links back to Xero for deeper analysis. Claude connects with read-only access. Any data retrieved is used only to respond to your questions and is never stored between sessions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Xero to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Xero to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.xero.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Xero MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Xero scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Xero MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Xero provides these MCP tools: get_financial_position, get_cash_position, get_profit_and_loss, get_top_customers_by_revenue, get_organisation_financial_year, get_organisation_info, get_aged_receivables, get_aged_payables, get_invoices, show_invoices_summary, and get_contacts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Xero?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Xero in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Xero requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Xero failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Xero scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Xero is developed by Xero Limited. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
